basic_details.job_title: IIT Tirupati Post Doctoral Fellow Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: The Department of Electrical Engineering at IIT Tirupati is seeking one Post Doctoral Fellow (PDF) under the Visvesvaraya Scheme (AY 2026-27), sponsored by the Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology (MeitY), Government of India. The temporary position carries a consolidated monthly fellowship of Rs, 1,08,393 for a maximum tenure of one year. how_to_apply: The notice gives the application link as https://forms.gle/bGGEdf7wDs2XnF6T7. Apply there by 4 December 2026, 5:00 PM. Eligible candidates must attach the following to the application:
A detailed CV specifying qualifications and experience.
Scanned copies of mark sheets and certificates from X class to date.
A brief statement of purpose (why the candidate is interested in this project topic), attached to the application link.
For queries, the notice gives the email address [email protected].

content_sections.heading: IIT Tirupati Post Doctoral Fellow at a Glance
content_sections.text: The official notification does not specify the application fee.

rows.details: Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology (MeitY), under Government of India
Below 40 years as on the date of applications

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Only Indian citizens may apply. The essential qualifications are: PhD in Electrical Engineering / Electronics Engineering / Electronics and Communication Engineering / Computer Science & Engineering / Closely Allied Departments of Engineering. First class in all preceding degrees. PhD should have been completed within the past 5 years. The age limit is below 40 years as on the date of applications. The notice states that essential qualifications will be relaxed for the outstanding candidate. Not eligible: PhD graduates of the host Institute (IIT Tirupati) are not permitted for this position. PDFs who have availed this scheme once are not permitted to apply again. Candidates should check the official notification for the discipline-specific eligibility of the post.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: IIT Tirupati reserves the right to discontinue the position with 1-month notice if the performance is not satisfactory.

rows.pay_tenure: Consolidated monthly fellowship Rs, 1,08,393 / month; maximum tenure of assignment one year

content_sections.heading: IIT Tirupati Post Doctoral Fellow Job Description
content_sections.text: The notice lists the following research areas of PDF work: Signal Processing (Computer Vision & Deep Learning) Wireless Networks/Communication Quantum Computing (Quantum Information Theory or Information theory)

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for IIT Tirupati Post Doctoral Fellow
content_sections.text: The notice gives the application link as https://forms.gle/bGGEdf7wDs2XnF6T7 . Apply there by 4 December 2026, 5:00 PM. Eligible candidates must attach the following to the application: A detailed CV specifying qualifications and experience. Scanned copies of mark sheets and certificates from X class to date. A brief statement of purpose (why the candidate is interested in this project topic), attached to the application link. For queries, the notice gives the email address [email protected] .

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Selection will be based on qualification, experience, and an in-person/online interview at IIT Tirupati. Shortlisted candidates will be informed by email only, and the interview date will be notified to them by email. The notice states that no TA/DA shall be paid to candidates appearing for an interview online or offline.

faq.question: Q1. How many Post Doctoral Fellow vacancies are there at IIT Tirupati?
faq.answer: There is one required position for the Post Doctoral Fellow under the Visvesvaraya Scheme in the Department of Electrical Engineering.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for the IIT Tirupati Post Doctoral Fellow position?
faq.answer: The last date of application is 4 December 2026 (5:00 PM).

faq.question: Q3. What is the qualification required?
faq.answer: A PhD in Electrical, Electronics, Electronics and Communication or Computer Science & Engineering, or a closely allied department of engineering, with first class in all preceding degrees. The PhD must have been completed within the past 5 years.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit?
faq.answer: The age limit is below 40 years as on the date of applications.

faq.question: Q5. What is the fellowship amount?
faq.answer: The consolidated monthly fellowship is Rs, 1,08,393 / month.

faq.question: Q6. How do I apply?
faq.answer: Apply through the application link given in the notice, attaching a detailed CV, scanned mark sheets and certificates from X class to date, and a brief statement of purpose.

faq.question: Q7. How are candidates selected?
faq.answer: Selection is based on qualification, experience, and an in-person/online interview at IIT Tirupati. Shortlisted candidates are informed by email only.

faq.question: Q8. Is this a permanent job?
faq.answer: No. It is a temporary position with a maximum tenure of one year, and IIT Tirupati reserves the right to discontinue it with 1-month notice if performance is not satisfactory.

faq.question: Q9. Can IIT Tirupati PhD graduates apply?
faq.answer: No. PhD graduates of the host Institute (IIT Tirupati) are not permitted for this position, and PDFs who have availed this scheme once cannot apply again.

faq.question: Q10. Is TA/DA paid for the interview?
faq.answer: No. The notice states that no TA/DA shall be paid to candidates appearing for an interview online or offline.
